text: When we look to the individuals of the same variety or sub-variety of our older cultivated plants and animals, one of the first points which strikes us, is, that they generally differ much more from each other, than do the individuals of any one species or variety in a state of nature. When we look to the individuals of some one species or variety in a state of nature, and an animal of the same species or variety, which strikingly was that they generally differed much more from each other, than do the individuals of any one species or variety.

When we look to the individuals of the same variety or sub-variety of our older cultivated plants and animals, one of the first points which strikes us,
 is,
 that they generally differ much more from each other,
 than do the individuals of any one species or variety in a state of nature.

When we look to the individuals of some one species or variety in a state of nature,
 and an animal of the same species or variety,
 which strikingly was that they generally differed much more from each other,
 than do the individuals of any one species or variety.
